name: delta-hydraulic-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing 2D hydraulic flood simulation, multi-scenario intervention evaluation, and Atlassian Teamwork Graph dependencies for municipal crisis response.

tools.name: delta_get_catchment_state
tools.description: Retrieves the authoritative 64x64 Boston Longwood catchment specifications, USGS elevation stats, 5 hospital complexes, and 3 drainage inlets.

includeFacilities.description: Whether to return full hospital complex metadata.

includeDrainage.description: Whether to return drainage culverts and nominal capacities.

tools.name: delta_step_hydraulic_simulation
tools.description: Executes 2D mass-conserving diffusive-wave shallow water equations across the 4,096-cell grid with adaptive CFL sub-stepping.

durationSeconds.description: Elapsed duration of flood wave to simulate in seconds (default: 600).

rainfallIntensityMmPerHour.description: Rainfall precipitation rate applied across catchment (default: 35.0 mm/h).

tools.name: delta_evaluate_interventions
tools.description: Runs deterministic multi-scenario simulation comparing Plan Alpha (sandbags), Plan Beta (mobile pump), and Plan Gamma (culvert jetting) against an invariant baseline storm.

simulatedSeconds.description: Duration of comparison run in seconds (default: 1800).

stormBurstRateMmPerHour.description: Design storm burst intensity in mm/h (default: 35.0).

tools.name: delta_get_decision_records
tools.description: Queries immutable Decision Records stored in Forge Key-Value Storage (KVS) signed by human Incident Commanders.

tools.name: delta_query_teamwork_graph
tools.description: Traverses Atlassian Teamwork Graph nodes and dependencies connecting healthcare facilities, drainage culverts, and Jira incident work orders.

facilityId.description: Filter dependencies for a specific facility (e.g. 'FACILITY-BWH').
